tools.name: add_reference_variable
tools.description: Set reference variables on a service. Each variable value must be a Railway reference expression starting with '${{' (e.g. '${{ Postgres.DATABASE_URL }}').

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

variables.description: Variables to set, each with a name and a reference value starting with "${{".

tools.name: connect_service_source
tools.description: Connect an existing Railway service to a GitHub repo or Docker image. For GitHub repos, this enables Railway-managed deployment triggers when the project has GitHub App access.

branch.description: Git branch to deploy when source_repo is set. Defaults to the repo default branch when Railway can see it.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

source_repo.description: GitHub repo to connect, in owner/repo format.

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Create a new object storage bucket in a Railway environment. Default region is sjc. Returns the bucket ID and name.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

region.description: Region: sjc, iad, ams, or sin (default: sjc).

tools.name: create_environment
tools.description: Create a new environment in a Railway project. Optionally fork from an existing environment.

name.description: The name for the new environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

source_environment_id.description: Source environment ID to fork from.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new Railway project. Returns the project ID and the default environment ID.

name.description: The name for the new project.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the project in. If omitted, uses the user's personal workspace.

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Create a new service in a Railway project. Optionally connect a GitHub repo or Docker image.

branch.description: Git branch to deploy when source_repo is set. Defaults to the repo default branch when Railway can see it.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

tools.name: create_tcp_proxy
tools.description: Create a public TCP proxy for a Railway service application port. Only one TCP proxy is allowed per service instance.

application_port.description: Application port to expose through the TCP proxy.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: create_volume
tools.description: Create a persistent volume and attach it to a service at the given mount path.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Delete a custom or service domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Deploy code from a directory to Railway. Creates a tarball, uploads it, and starts a deployment. Returns the deployment ID and URLs. Use get_logs to monitor progress.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

message.description: Message to attach to the deployment.

path.description: Path to the directory to deploy. Defaults to current directory.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the linked service or backboard auto-creates one.

tools.name: deploy_template
tools.description: Deploy a Railway template by its code (e.g. 'postgres', 'redis'). Returns the workflow ID to track deployment progress.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

tools.name: disconnect_service_source
tools.description: Disconnect an existing Railway service from its current source.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Railway documentation page. Accepts a docs URL (e.g. https://docs.railway.com/guides/getting-started) or a slug (e.g. guides/getting-started). Use docs_search first to find the right page.

url.description: The documentation page URL (e.g. "https://docs.railway.com/guides/getting-started") or slug (e.g. "guides/getting-started").

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search Railway documentation by keyword. Returns a list of matching page URLs. Use docs_fetch to read the full content of a specific page.

query.description: Search query to find Railway documentation pages.

tools.name: domain_status
tools.description: Show status for a service or custom domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. Includes DNS records, verification status, certificate status/errors, sync status, and target port.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: environment_status
tools.description: Get the deployment status of all services in a Railway environment. Returns a table of service name, status, replica count, and latest deploy time.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

tools.name: generate_domain
tools.description: Add a domain to a service. If 'domain' is provided, creates a custom domain and returns required DNS records. If omitted, generates a Railway service domain (or returns existing domains).

domain.description: Custom domain to add (e.g. "api.example.com"). If omitted, generates a Railway service domain.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Get build, deploy, or HTTP logs for a service's deployment. Set log_type to 'build', 'deploy', or 'http'. Supports filtering by level/search for build/deploy logs, and method/status/path/request_id for HTTP logs. If no deployment_id is provided, uses the latest deployment.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment ID to get logs for. If omitted, uses the latest deployment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

level.description: Filter by log level: "error", "warn", or "info" (for build/deploy logs).

lines.description: Number of log lines to return (default: 100).

method.description: Filter HTTP logs by request method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS (requires log_type: "http").

path.description: Filter HTTP logs by request path, e.g. "/api/users" (requires log_type: "http").

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

request_id.description: Filter HTTP logs by request ID (requires log_type: "http").

search.description: Search string to filter logs (for build/deploy logs).

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

since.description: Start time filter. Supports relative ("30m", "2h", "1d") or ISO 8601 format.

status.description: Filter HTTP logs by status code. Accepts: exact (200), comparison (>=400), or range (500..599) (requires log_type: "http").

until.description: End time filter. Supports relative ("30m", "2h", "1d") or ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: get_service_config
tools.description: Get the current configuration of a service instance including source, build config, start command, and variable count.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: get_tcp_proxy
tools.description: Get details for one public TCP proxy by ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

proxy.description: TCP proxy ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: http_error_rate
tools.description: Get the HTTP error rate (4xx + 5xx) as a percentage of total requests from recent HTTP logs.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment ID. If omitted, uses the latest deployment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

lines.description: Number of log entries to sample (default: 200).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: http_requests
tools.description: Get HTTP request counts grouped by status code bucket (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx) from recent HTTP logs.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment ID. If omitted, uses the latest deployment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

lines.description: Number of log entries to sample (default: 200).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: http_response_time
tools.description: Get HTTP response time percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99) in milliseconds from recent HTTP logs.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment ID. If omitted, uses the latest deployment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

lines.description: Number of log entries to sample (default: 200).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: link_environment
tools.description: Switch the linked environment for the current project directory. If no environment_id or environment_name is provided, lists available environments. Preserves the existing service link.

environment_id.description: The environment ID to link. If omitted along with environment_name, lists available environments.

environment_name.description: The environment name to link. Alternative to environment_id.

tools.name: link_service
tools.description: Link a service to the current project directory for the CLI. If no service_id or service_name is provided, lists available services. Uses a fresh config to write the link.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID to link. If omitted along with service_name, lists available services.

service_name.description: The service name to link. Alternative to service_id.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments for a service. Returns deployment IDs, status, timestamps, and commit hashes. If no IDs are provided, uses the currently linked project/service/environment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to return (default: 20).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List service and custom domains for a service. Returns domain, type, ID, target port, and sync status.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the user's Railway account, grouped by workspace. Returns project names and IDs.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all services in a Railway project. If no project_id is provided, uses the currently linked project.

project_id.description: The project ID to use. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

tools.name: list_tcp_proxies
tools.description: List public TCP proxies for a Railway service. Returns endpoint, ID, proxy port, application port, and sync status.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List all environment variables for a service. Returns KEY=VALUE pairs. If no IDs are provided, uses the currently linked project/service/environment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all Railway workspaces available to the current user. Returns workspace names, IDs, team IDs, and project counts. Use the workspace ID with create_project.

tools.name: private_network_status
tools.description: Get private networking status for a service. Returns full hostname, short name, network name/ID, sync status, address family, and private IPs. If network is omitted, returns all private networks in the environment.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

network.description: Private network name, ID, or DNS name. If omitted, status returns all networks.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: private_network_update
tools.description: Update the private networking endpoint name for a service. Name must be the short prefix without the .internal suffix. If network is omitted, uses the only private network or the network named railway.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

name.description: Endpoint name prefix, without the .internal suffix.

network.description: Private network name, ID, or DNS name. If omitted, uses the only network or the network named "railway".

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: remove_bucket
tools.description: Remove an object storage bucket from a Railway environment. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

tools.name: remove_service
tools.description: Remove a service from a Railway project. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: remove_tcp_proxy
tools.description: Remove a public TCP proxy by ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port. This is irreversible and returns a preview first.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

proxy.description: TCP proxy ID, domain, endpoint, proxy port, or application port.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: remove_volume
tools.description: Remove a persistent volume by ID. This is irreversible. Returns a preview first.

tools.name: retry_domain_certificate
tools.description: Retry failed TLS certificate issuance for a custom domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. Custom domains only. Returns updated status after readback.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: scale_service
tools.description: Scale one service across Railway deploy regions using friendly region names or region IDs. Provide replicas as a map, e.g. {"eu-west": 2, "us-east": 1}. Maximum 50 total replicas across regions.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

replicas.description: Map of friendly region names or region IDs to replica counts, e.g. {"eu-west": 2, "us-east": 1}. Maximum 50 total replicas across regions.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search for Railway templates using Railway's backend-ranked template search. Returns matching templates with their codes.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor for fetching the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Search query to send to Railway template search.

tools.name: service_metrics
tools.description: Get CPU and memory (or other) metrics for a service. Returns recent data points and average values for the specified time window.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

hours_back.description: Number of hours back to query (default: 1).

measurements.description: Metrics to fetch: CPU_USAGE, MEMORY_USAGE_GB, DISK_USAGE_GB, NETWORK_RX_GB, NETWORK_TX_GB. Defaults to CPU_USAGE and MEMORY_USAGE_GB.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: set_variables
tools.description: Set one or more environment variables on a service. Pass variables as a JSON object mapping names to values. Triggers a redeploy unless skip_deploys is true.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

skip_deploys.description: If true, skip triggering redeploys after setting variables.

variables.description: Map of variable names to values to set.

tools.name: update_domain
tools.description: Update a custom or service domain by domain name, URL, or domain ID. Supports target port changes for both domain types and Railway service-domain renames via new_domain. Port must be from 1 to 65535. Returns updated status after readback.

domain.description: Domain name, URL, or domain ID.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

new_domain.description: Rename a Railway-provided service domain. Accepts a full service domain or host label.

port.description: Target port for the domain. Must be from 1 to 65535.

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Update service instance settings such as build command, start command, health check, sleep mode, root directory, cron schedule, Dockerfile path, restart policy, pre-deploy command, Railway config file, and watch patterns. Use scale_service for replicas and regions.

environment_id.description: The environment ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked environment.

num_replicas.description: Legacy single-region replica count. Prefer scale_service for replica changes.

pre_deploy_command.description: Commands to run before deploying (e.g. database migrations).

project_id.description: The project ID. If omitted, uses the currently linked project.

railway_config_file.description: Path to the Railway config file.

region.description: Legacy deploy region ID. Prefer scale_service for region replica changes.

restart_policy_max_retries.description: Maximum number of restart retries (used with ON_FAILURE restart policy).

service_id.description: The service ID or name. If omitted, uses the currently linked service.

sleep_application.description: Whether to sleep the service when inactive.

watch_patterns.description: File watch patterns that trigger deploys.

tools.name: update_volume
tools.description: Update a volume's name or mount path. Provide environment_id and service_id when updating mount_path.

environment_id.description: The environment ID (required when updating mount_path).

service_id.description: The service ID (used when updating mount_path).

tools.description: Check Railway authentication status and return the current user
